pr.title: feat(config): comment_min_age_secs to settle edited comments
pr.body:
feat(config): comment_min_age_secs to settle edited comments

<!-- git-stk:description -->
Adds `general.comment_min_age_secs` (default 0 = off): hold a comment until it's at least this old before notifying, so a bot that posts a placeholder and edits it in place ("Claude Code is working…" → the finished review) settles to its final text and you get one accurate alert.

A too-fresh comment is skipped *and* left out of the snapshot's seen-set, so it re-derives next poll and emits its settled body then. `created_at`-based, so edits within the window are captured on the re-fetch. Threaded through `DiffContext` for GitHub and Gitea.

Closes #55.
<!-- /git-stk:description -->

<!-- git-stk:closes -->
Closes #55
<!-- /git-stk:closes -->

expected.description: The Gitea source passes comment_min_age: None to the diff, so the configured comment_min_age_secs it parses is ignored for Gitea while GitHub honors it.
